description: ORIENT FIRST — show THIS key's account before you spend a metered call: the org it is bound to, the current plan, a per-feature entitlements map, and per-call cost ceilings. READ `balance`, NOT `included`. CueFrame is credit-funded: rendering (entitlements.exports), generation (generate), preview stills (compose_capture), the judge (compose_verify) and the Director (compose) have NO separate per-plan allowance — they all spend one shared wallet, named in `fundedBy` (`credits`; generation is metered in provider-cost units against that wallet). Each `balance` restates that ONE wallet in that feature's own unit at `creditCost` credits per unit, so they are alternative ways to spend the same money, not four budgets. Each entitlement also carries `listUsdPerUnit`: the dollar quote for ONE unit before you call (0 = a plan grant that draws no credits, e.g. resource_import — stock search + import are free; null = not quotable up front). Check the requested cost against the balance. For generation, also check generationLimit: free accounts have a separate provider-cost cap even with a positive wallet. A billing_required error with reason free_generation_cap requires a credit-pack purchase through normal checkout. `included:false` means the plan genuinely lacks the feature. Every new org starts with a free credit grant, so an account with an empty usage history can still render, generate, preview and score. costCeilings.generateMediaUsdPerCall is the generate_media per-call USD cap. No args — identity is resolved from your key (never echoed from input).
name: get_account

billingConfigured.description: false = billing is not configured in this environment, so plan/entitlement values are best-effort and may be null (unknown), not authoritative.

costCeilings.description: Discoverable per-call cost ceilings so an agent can price/right-size a request before a guaranteed 402.

displayName.description: Org/customer display name from the billing record; null when not set or unknown.

entitlements.description: Per-feature entitlements keyed by featureId. Covers the billing-gated capabilities: `exports` gates create_render AND generate_media output; `compose` gates compose; `brand_kits` gates create_brand_kit; `resource_import` gates import_resource (a boolean grant: `listUsdPerUnit` 0 — stock search and import cost no credits for a keyed caller); plus ai_tokens/storage/compose_verify/compose_capture/etc. Read `listUsdPerUnit` for what one unit costs before you spend it. Most capabilities are CREDIT-FUNDED — `included` is true and the real limit is `balance`, drawn from the shared wallet named in `fundedBy` (`credits` — generation included; a free org is additionally bounded by a generation cap). So read `balance`, not `included`, to decide whether you can afford a call; `included:false` means the plan genuinely lacks the feature. Check BEFORE a metered call to avoid a mid-workflow 402 billing_required (whose error `details.featureId` names the gating feature).

generationLimit.description: Separate lifetime generation cap before a credit-pack purchase. Wallet balance is still shared; generation must also fit this remaining provider-cost allowance. null means unknown.

orgId.description: The org this API key is bound to — resolved server-side from the Authorization credential, NEVER from the request body/query.

plan.description: The customer's current base plan/tier. null = unknown (billing not configured, or no active plan resolvable yet).

surfaces.description: The browser URLs that actually exist, so an agent asked to "show me" can hand the user a real link instead of guessing one from an id. A null means the surface is not built, not that it is hidden from this key.

title: Get Account
